[4:19PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

There is slow vehicular movement while descending from CMS Bridge toward Offin Canal Market, primarily due to heavy traffic flow and market-related activities in the area. However, traffic improves significantly after Offin Canal, with smooth movement along the stretch leading to Ijora Olopa via the NEPA intersection.

Traffic remains steady along Broad Street, extending through the Apongbon underbridge, connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, despite ongoing market activities.

Eko Bridge inward Apongbon, providing access to CMS, is experiencing good vehicular flow.

Similarly, the descent from Idumota Bridge inward Ebute-Ero, through Leventis and the UBA Roundabout, linking both inner and outer Marina routes, is currently flowing smoothly.

At this time, there are no major impediments. Our personnel are on ground and actively managing traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA
